name: Nasi Lemak
description: Nasi santan, sambal, ikan bilis, kacang dan telur. Raja segala sarapan.
descriptionEn: Coconut rice with sambal, anchovies, peanuts and egg. The king of breakfast.

name: Nasi Kandar
description: Nasi dengan kuah campur banjir dan lauk pilihan. Ala Penang.
descriptionEn: Rice flooded with mixed curries and your pick of sides. Penang style.

name: Nasi Ayam
description: Nasi ayam rebus atau panggang dengan sos cili dan sup.
descriptionEn: Poached or roasted chicken rice with chilli sauce and soup.

name: Nasi Goreng Kampung
description: Nasi goreng dengan ikan bilis, kangkung dan cili padi.
descriptionEn: Village-style fried rice with anchovies, water spinach and bird's eye chilli.

name: Nasi Kerabu
description: Nasi biru Kelantan dengan ulam, kerisik dan ikan goreng.
descriptionEn: Kelantan blue rice with fresh herbs, toasted coconut and fried fish.

name: Nasi Dagang
description: Nasi santan Terengganu dengan gulai ikan tongkol.
descriptionEn: Terengganu coconut rice with tuna curry.

name: Nasi Campur
description: Ambil sendiri lauk kegemaran. Pilihan selamat bila tak tahu nak makan apa.
descriptionEn: Pick your own sides. The safe choice when you can't decide.

name: Nasi Briyani
description: Nasi berempah dengan ayam atau kambing dan dalca.
descriptionEn: Spiced rice with chicken or mutton and dalca.

name: Nasi Daun Pisang
description: Nasi atas daun pisang dengan sayur, papadom dan kari. Makan guna tangan!
descriptionEn: Rice on a banana leaf with vegetables, papadum and curry. Eat with your hands!

name: Nasi Kukus Ayam Dara
description: Nasi kukus dengan ayam goreng berempah dan kuah kari.
descriptionEn: Steamed rice with spiced fried chicken and curry.

name: Nasi Char Siu
description: Nasi dengan daging babi panggang manis dan sos.
descriptionEn: Rice with sweet roast pork and sauce.

name: Claypot Chicken Rice
description: Nasi ayam dalam periuk tanah dengan lap cheong. Kerak bawah paling sedap.
descriptionEn: Chicken rice cooked in a clay pot with Chinese sausage. The crispy bottom is the best part.

name: Char Kway Teow
description: Kuey teow goreng api besar dengan udang, kerang dan taugeh.
descriptionEn: Flat rice noodles stir-fried over high heat with prawns, cockles and bean sprouts.

name: Mee Goreng Mamak
description: Mee kuning goreng dengan kentang, tauhu dan perahan limau.
descriptionEn: Fried yellow noodles with potato, tofu and a squeeze of lime.

name: Maggi Goreng
description: Menu wajib lepak mamak tengah malam. Tambah telur mata.
descriptionEn: The must-order at a late-night mamak hangout. Add a fried egg.

name: Asam Laksa
description: Kuah ikan masam pedas Penang dengan nanas, bunga kantan dan petis.
descriptionEn: Penang's sour, spicy fish broth with pineapple, ginger flower and shrimp paste.

name: Kari Laksa
description: Mee dalam kuah kari santan dengan tauhu pok dan ayam.
descriptionEn: Noodles in coconut curry broth with tofu puffs and chicken.

name: Laksa Johor
description: Spaghetti dalam kuah ikan dan kerisik dengan ulam. Kebanggaan Johor.
descriptionEn: Spaghetti in fish and toasted coconut gravy with fresh herbs. Johor's pride.

name: Mee Rebus
description: Mee kuning dengan kuah keledek pekat, telur rebus dan cili.
descriptionEn: Yellow noodles in thick sweet potato gravy with boiled egg and chilli.

name: Mee Bandung Muar
description: Mee dalam kuah udang pekat dan telur. Asal dari Muar.
descriptionEn: Noodles in a rich prawn broth with egg. Originally from Muar.

name: Wantan Mee
description: Mee kering dengan sos gelap, sayur dan wantan.
descriptionEn: Dry egg noodles with dark sauce, greens and wontons.

name: Pan Mee
description: Mee buatan tangan dalam sup ikan bilis dengan sayur manis.
descriptionEn: Hand-made noodles in anchovy soup with sweet leaf greens.

name: Hokkien Mee KL
description: Mee tebal goreng dengan kicap pekat dan lemak babi.
descriptionEn: Thick noodles fried in dark soy sauce and pork lard.

name: Bihun Sup
description: Bihun dalam sup ayam panas dengan sambal kicap. Sesuai masa hujan.
descriptionEn: Rice vermicelli in hot chicken soup with chilli soy sauce. Perfect on a rainy day.

name: Laksa Sarawak
description: Bihun dalam kuah sambal belacan dan santan dengan udang dan telur dadar.
descriptionEn: Vermicelli in sambal and coconut broth with prawns and omelette strips.

name: Mee Kolok
description: Mee kering Sarawak dengan bawang goreng dan daging hiris.
descriptionEn: Sarawak dry noodles with fried shallots and sliced meat.

name: Roti Canai
description: Roti leper rangup dengan dal dan kari. Kosong, telur atau bawang?
descriptionEn: Crispy flatbread with dhal and curry. Plain, egg or onion?

name: Murtabak
description: Roti berinti daging cincang, telur dan bawang, dengan acar.
descriptionEn: Flatbread stuffed with minced meat, egg and onion, served with pickles.

name: Thosai
description: Lempeng nipis tepung beras dengan chutney kelapa dan sambar.
descriptionEn: Thin rice-flour crepe with coconut chutney and sambar.

name: Chapati
description: Roti gandum tanpa minyak dengan dal. Pilihan ringan.
descriptionEn: Oil-free wholewheat flatbread with dhal. The lighter option.

name: Roti John
description: Roti panjang dengan telur dan daging cincang, sos cili dan mayonis.
descriptionEn: Long bread with egg and minced meat, chilli sauce and mayonnaise.

name: Burger Ramly
description: Burger tepi jalan berbalut telur dengan sos melimpah.
descriptionEn: Street-side burger wrapped in egg with plenty of sauce.

name: Satay
description: Daging cucuk bakar dengan kuah kacang, nasi impit dan timun.
descriptionEn: Grilled meat skewers with peanut sauce, rice cakes and cucumber.

name: Ayam Penyet
description: Ayam goreng dipenyek dengan sambal pedas berapi.
descriptionEn: Smashed fried chicken with fiery hot sambal.

name: Ikan Bakar
description: Ikan segar bakar atas daun pisang dengan air asam.
descriptionEn: Fresh fish grilled on banana leaf with tamarind dip.

name: Rendang Daging
description: Daging masak perlahan dalam santan dan rempah sampai kering.
descriptionEn: Beef slow-cooked in coconut milk and spices until dry.

name: Tom Yam
description: Sup masam pedas dari kedai tomyam. Campur, seafood atau ayam.
descriptionEn: Hot and sour soup from a tomyam shop. Mixed, seafood or chicken.

name: Sup Tulang
description: Sup tulang lembu berempah, sedut sumsum guna straw.
descriptionEn: Spiced beef bone soup. Suck the marrow out with a straw.

name: Sup Kambing
description: Sup kambing pekat berempah dengan roti atau nasi.
descriptionEn: Thick spiced mutton soup with bread or rice.

name: Bak Kut Teh
description: Sup herba dengan tulang rusuk babi. Klang punya famous.
descriptionEn: Herbal soup with pork ribs. Klang's famous one.

name: Steamboat
description: Celur sendiri seafood, daging dan sayur dalam periuk kongsi. Best ramai-ramai.
descriptionEn: Cook your own seafood, meat and vegetables in a shared pot. Best in a group.

name: Yong Tau Foo
description: Pilih sendiri tauhu dan sayur bersumbat ikan, dalam sup atau kering.
descriptionEn: Pick your own fish-stuffed tofu and vegetables, in soup or dry.

name: Dim Sum
description: Pau, siew mai dan har gow dalam bakul kukus. Cari kedai dim sum halal.
descriptionEn: Buns, siew mai and har gow in steamer baskets. Look for a halal dim sum shop.

name: Popiah
description: Kulit nipis berisi sengkuang, telur dan sos manis.
descriptionEn: Thin crepe rolls filled with jicama, egg and sweet sauce.

name: Lok Lok
description: Pilih cucuk, celur, celup sos kacang. Aktiviti malam yang sempurna.
descriptionEn: Pick skewers, blanch them, dip in peanut sauce. The perfect night out.

name: Keropok Lekor
description: Keropok ikan Terengganu goreng dengan sos cili. Snek petang.
descriptionEn: Terengganu fried fish crackers with chilli sauce. A teatime snack.

name: Pisang Goreng
description: Cekodok pisang rangup panas-panas dengan kopi O.
descriptionEn: Hot, crispy banana fritters with black coffee.

name: Karipap
description: Pastri berinti kentang kari. Beli lima, makan semua.
descriptionEn: Pastry filled with curried potato. Buy five, eat all five.

name: Rojak Buah
description: Buah dan sayur dengan kuah petis pekat dan kacang tumbuk.
descriptionEn: Fruit and vegetables in thick shrimp paste sauce with crushed peanuts.

name: Cendol
description: Ais dengan cendol hijau, santan dan gula Melaka. Penyelamat hari panas.
descriptionEn: Shaved ice with green jelly, coconut milk and palm sugar. A hot-day saviour.

name: Ais Kacang (ABC)
description: Ais kisar dengan kacang merah, jagung, cincau dan susu.
descriptionEn: Shaved ice with red beans, corn, grass jelly and milk.

name: Apam Balik
description: Lempeng lipat berisi kacang, gula dan jagung. Nipis rangup atau tebal?
descriptionEn: Folded pancake filled with peanuts, sugar and corn. Thin and crispy or thick?

name: Hinava
description: Ikan mentah diperap limau, cili dan halia. Tradisi Kadazan-Dusun Sabah.
descriptionEn: Raw fish cured in lime, chilli and ginger. A Kadazan-Dusun tradition from Sabah.

name: Roti Tisu
description: Roti nipis tinggi macam kon, disiram gula dan susu pekat.
descriptionEn: Paper-thin bread shaped like a cone, drizzled with sugar and condensed milk.

name: Chicken Chop
description: Ayam goreng tepung atau grill dengan sos lada hitam, kentang dan coleslaw.
descriptionEn: Crumbed or grilled chicken with black pepper sauce, fries and coleslaw.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Spaghetti dengan sos tomato daging cincang. Menu wajib kedai western.
descriptionEn: Spaghetti with minced meat tomato sauce. A western stall classic.

name: Sushi
description: Nasi cuka dengan ikan dan seafood. Kedai sushi conveyor senang jumpa di mall.
descriptionEn: Vinegared rice with fish and seafood. Conveyor sushi is easy to find in malls.

name: Ramen
description: Mee Jepun dalam sup pekat dengan telur separuh masak. Cari kedai ramen halal.
descriptionEn: Japanese noodles in rich broth with a soft-boiled egg. Look for a halal ramen shop.

name: Korean Fried Chicken
description: Ayam goreng rangup disalut sos gochujang manis pedas.
descriptionEn: Crispy fried chicken coated in sweet and spicy gochujang sauce.

name: Tteokbokki
description: Kek beras kenyal dalam sos merah pedas manis.
descriptionEn: Chewy rice cakes in a sweet and spicy red sauce.

name: Teh Tarik
description: Teh susu ditarik sampai berbuih. Kurang manis kalau nak sihat sikit.
descriptionEn: Milk tea pulled until frothy. Ask for kurang manis if you want less sugar.

name: Milo Ais
description: Milo sejuk pekat. Nak lagi gila, order Milo Dinosaur.
descriptionEn: Thick iced Milo. For extra, order a Milo Dinosaur.

name: Kopi O
description: Kopi hitam kopitiam yang pekat. Kawan baik roti bakar dan telur separuh masak.
descriptionEn: Strong black kopitiam coffee. Best friends with kaya toast and soft-boiled eggs.

name: Air Bandung
description: Sirap mawar dengan susu, sejuk dan merah jambu.
descriptionEn: Rose syrup with milk, cold and pink.

name: Nasi Goreng Pattaya
description: Nasi goreng berbalut telur dadar nipis, disiram sos cili.
descriptionEn: Fried rice wrapped in a thin omelette, topped with chilli sauce.

name: Mee Siam
description: Bihun dalam kuah manis masam pedas dengan telur dan tauhu.
descriptionEn: Rice vermicelli in a sweet, sour and spicy gravy with egg and tofu.

name: Lontong
description: Nasi impit dalam kuah lodeh santan dengan sambal.
descriptionEn: Compressed rice cakes in coconut vegetable curry with sambal.

name: Soto Ayam
description: Sup ayam berempah dengan nasi impit atau mee dan sambal kicap.
descriptionEn: Fragrant chicken soup with rice cakes or noodles and sambal kicap.

name: Bubur Ayam
description: Bubur nasi lembut dengan ayam carik, halia dan bawang goreng.
descriptionEn: Soft rice porridge with shredded chicken, ginger and fried shallots.

name: Roti Bakar Kaya
description: Roti bakar dengan kaya dan mentega, bersama telur separuh masak.
descriptionEn: Toast with kaya jam and butter, with soft-boiled eggs on the side.

name: Kuih Lapis
description: Kuih kukus berlapis warna-warni yang lembut dan kenyal.
descriptionEn: Soft, chewy layered steamed cake in bright colours.

name: Onde-Onde
description: Bebola tepung pandan berinti gula Melaka, disalut kelapa parut.
descriptionEn: Pandan rice balls filled with melted palm sugar, rolled in coconut.

name: Otak-Otak
description: Isi ikan berempah dibakar dalam daun pisang atau nipah.
descriptionEn: Spiced fish paste grilled in banana or nipah leaves.

name: Asam Pedas
description: Ikan dalam kuah asam jawa masam pedas. Kegemaran Melaka dan Johor.
descriptionEn: Fish in a sour, spicy tamarind gravy. Melaka and Johor favourite.

name: Putu Piring
description: Kuih tepung beras kukus berinti gula Melaka, dengan kelapa parut.
descriptionEn: Steamed rice flour cakes filled with palm sugar, served with coconut.

name: Nasi Ulam
description: Nasi digaul dengan ulam-ulaman, isi ikan dan kerisik.
descriptionEn: Rice tossed with finely chopped fresh herbs, fish and toasted coconut.

name: Gado-Gado
description: Sayur rebus, tauhu, telur dan keropok dengan kuah kacang.
descriptionEn: Blanched vegetables, tofu, egg and crackers in peanut sauce.

name: Bakso
description: Bebola daging dalam sup jernih dengan mee.
descriptionEn: Beef meatballs in clear broth with noodles.

name: Nasi Padang
description: Nasi dengan pelbagai lauk Minang seperti rendang dan gulai.
descriptionEn: Rice with a spread of rich Minang curries like rendang and gulai.

name: Mie Ayam
description: Mee dengan ayam kicap manis, sayur dan semangkuk sup.
descriptionEn: Noodles with sweet soy chicken, greens and a bowl of broth.

name: Martabak Manis
description: Lempeng tebal manis dilipat dengan coklat, keju atau kacang.
descriptionEn: Thick sweet pancake folded with chocolate, cheese or peanuts.

name: Rawon
description: Sup daging hitam Jawa Timur yang diwarnakan buah keluak.
descriptionEn: East Javanese black beef soup coloured with keluak nuts.

name: Pad Thai
description: Kuey teow goreng dengan asam jawa, telur, kacang dan limau.
descriptionEn: Stir-fried rice noodles with tamarind, egg, peanuts and lime.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Kari santan cili hijau dengan daun selasih dan ayam.
descriptionEn: Creamy coconut curry with green chilli, basil and chicken.

name: Som Tam
description: Kerabu betik muda ditumbuk, masam manis dan sangat pedas.
descriptionEn: Pounded green papaya salad, sour, sweet and very spicy.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Pulut manis dengan mangga masak dan santan.
descriptionEn: Sweet sticky rice with ripe mango and coconut cream.

name: Pad Kra Pao
description: Daging cincang goreng daun selasih atas nasi dengan telur mata.
descriptionEn: Holy basil stir-fry with minced meat over rice and a fried egg.

name: Tom Kha Gai
description: Sup ayam santan dengan lengkuas, serai dan limau.
descriptionEn: Coconut chicken soup with galangal, lemongrass and lime.

name: Boat Noodles
description: Mangkuk kecil mee sup Thai yang pekat. Biasanya babi atau daging.
descriptionEn: Small bowls of rich, dark Thai noodle soup. Usually pork or beef.

name: Thai Iced Tea
description: Teh berwarna oren dengan susu pekat atas ais.
descriptionEn: Bright orange spiced tea with condensed milk over ice.

name: Pho
description: Mee beras Vietnam dalam sup daging dengan herba dan limau.
descriptionEn: Vietnamese rice noodle soup with beef, herbs and lime.

name: Banh Mi
description: Baguette rangup dengan pâté, daging sejuk, jeruk dan daun ketumbar.
descriptionEn: Crusty baguette with pâté, cold cuts, pickles and coriander.

name: Bun Cha
description: Daging babi bakar dengan mee beras, herba dan sos celup. Klasik Hanoi.
descriptionEn: Grilled pork with rice noodles, herbs and dipping sauce. Hanoi classic.

name: Goi Cuon
description: Popiah basah kertas beras dengan udang, herba dan sos kacang.
descriptionEn: Fresh rice paper rolls with prawns, herbs and peanut dip.

name: Ca Phe Sua Da
description: Kopi titis pekat dengan susu pekat atas ais.
descriptionEn: Strong drip coffee with condensed milk over ice.

name: Com Tam
description: Nasi beras hancur dengan daging babi bakar, telur dan sos ikan.
descriptionEn: Broken rice with grilled pork chop, egg and fish sauce.

name: Chicken Adobo
description: Ayam masak cuka, kicap, bawang putih dan daun salam.
descriptionEn: Chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay leaf.

name: Sinigang
description: Sup asam jawa masam dengan sayur, selalunya dengan babi.
descriptionEn: Sour tamarind soup with vegetables, often with pork.

name: Lechon
description: Babi panggang sepenuh badan dengan kulit rangup. Hidangan kenduri.
descriptionEn: Whole roasted pig with crackling skin. Party food.

name: Halo-Halo
description: Ais kisar dengan susu, kacang, jeli, ubi ungu dan puding.
descriptionEn: Shaved ice with milk, beans, jelly, ube and leche flan.

name: Pancit Canton
description: Mee goreng dengan sayur dan daging. Mee hari jadi.
descriptionEn: Stir-fried egg noodles with vegetables and meat. Birthday noodles.

name: Mohinga
description: Mee beras dalam sup ikan dan serai. Sarapan Myanmar.
descriptionEn: Rice noodles in fish and lemongrass broth. Myanmar's breakfast.

name: Fish Amok
description: Kari ikan kukus berkrim santan, dimasak dalam daun pisang.
descriptionEn: Steamed fish curry custard with coconut, cooked in banana leaf.

name: Peking Duck
description: Kulit itik panggang rangup dibalut lempeng dengan sos hoisin.
descriptionEn: Crispy roast duck skin wrapped in pancakes with hoisin.

name: Mapo Tofu
description: Tauhu lembut dalam sos Sichuan pedas kebas dengan babi cincang.
descriptionEn: Silky tofu in numbing, fiery Sichuan sauce with minced pork.

name: Xiaolongbao
description: Ladu berisi babi dan sup panas di dalamnya.
descriptionEn: Soup dumplings filled with pork and hot broth.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Ayam goreng dengan cili kering, kacang dan lada Sichuan.
descriptionEn: Chicken stir-fried with dried chillies, peanuts and Sichuan pepper.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
description: Ayam rangup dalam sos nanas masam manis.
descriptionEn: Crispy chicken in tangy pineapple sauce.

name: Lanzhou Beef Noodles
description: Mee tarik dalam sup daging jernih dengan minyak cili. Tradisi halal Hui.
descriptionEn: Hand-pulled noodles in clear beef broth with chilli oil. Halal by tradition.

name: Jiaozi Dumplings
description: Ladu rebus atau goreng, biasanya isi babi dan kubis.
descriptionEn: Boiled or pan-fried dumplings, usually pork and cabbage.

name: Char Siu Bao
description: Pau kukus gebu berinti babi panggang manis.
descriptionEn: Fluffy steamed buns filled with sweet barbecue pork.

name: Egg Tart
description: Pastri rangup dengan kastard telur yang lembut.
descriptionEn: Flaky pastry with smooth, warm egg custard.

name: Bubble Tea
description: Teh susu dengan mutiara tapioka kenyal. Pilih tahap manis.
descriptionEn: Milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls. Choose your sugar level.

name: Taiwanese Beef Noodles
description: Daging lembu rebus dalam sup berempah pekat dengan mee tebal.
descriptionEn: Braised beef shank in rich spiced broth with thick noodles.

name: Tempura
description: Udang dan sayur bersalut tepung nipis yang rangup.
descriptionEn: Light, crispy battered prawns and vegetables.

name: Tonkatsu
description: Kepingan babi bersalut tepung roti, digoreng, dengan kubis hiris.
descriptionEn: Breaded deep-fried pork cutlet with shredded cabbage.

name: Udon
description: Mee gandum tebal dan kenyal dalam sup dashi ringan.
descriptionEn: Thick, chewy wheat noodles in a light dashi broth.

name: Takoyaki
description: Bebola sotong kurita dengan sos, mayonis dan serpihan ikan.
descriptionEn: Octopus balls topped with sauce, mayo and bonito flakes.

name: Okonomiyaki
description: Lempeng kubis berperisa, selalunya dengan babi, sos dan mayonis.
descriptionEn: Savoury cabbage pancake, often with pork, sauce and mayo.

name: Onigiri
description: Bebola nasi berbalut rumpai laut dengan isi tuna, salmon atau plum.
descriptionEn: Rice ball wrapped in seaweed with tuna, salmon or plum inside.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
description: Ayam goreng tepung rangup dengan kari Jepun manis dan nasi.
descriptionEn: Crispy chicken cutlet with mild, sweet Japanese curry and rice.

name: Gyudon
description: Nasi bertopping daging nipis masak manis dengan bawang.
descriptionEn: Rice bowl topped with thin sweet-savoury beef and onion.

name: Yakitori
description: Sate ayam Jepun disapu sos tare.
descriptionEn: Grilled chicken skewers glazed with tare sauce.

name: Sashimi
description: Hirisan ikan mentah dengan kicap dan wasabi.
descriptionEn: Thin slices of raw fish with soy sauce and wasabi.

name: Mochi
description: Kuih beras lembut dan kenyal, berinti kacang merah atau aiskrim.
descriptionEn: Soft, chewy rice cakes, often filled with red bean or ice cream.

name: Bibimbap
description: Nasi dengan sayur, daging, telur dan gochujang. Gaul semua.
descriptionEn: Rice bowl with vegetables, beef, egg and gochujang. Mix it all.

name: Bulgogi
description: Hirisan daging lembu perap manis, dibakar atau digoreng.
descriptionEn: Thin slices of sweet marinated beef, grilled or stir-fried.

name: Kimchi Jjigae
description: Rebusan kimchi pedas dengan tauhu, selalunya dengan babi.
descriptionEn: Spicy kimchi stew with tofu, often cooked with pork.

name: Samgyeopsal
description: Perut babi bakar dibalut salad dengan ssamjang.
descriptionEn: Grilled pork belly wrapped in lettuce with ssamjang.

name: Korean BBQ
description: Bakar sendiri daging dan ayam perap di atas meja.
descriptionEn: Grill your own marinated beef and chicken at the table.

name: Japchae
description: Soun goreng dengan sayur dan daging lembu.
descriptionEn: Glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables and beef.

name: Kimbap
description: Gulungan nasi rumpai laut dengan telur, sayur dan kek ikan.
descriptionEn: Seaweed rice rolls with egg, vegetables and fish cake.

name: Jjajangmyeon
description: Mee dalam sos kacang hitam pekat, biasanya dengan babi.
descriptionEn: Noodles in thick black bean sauce, traditionally with pork.

name: Bingsu
description: Ais susu halus dengan topping mangga atau kacang merah.
descriptionEn: Fluffy milk shaved ice with toppings like mango or red bean.

name: Ramyeon
description: Mee segera Korea pedas. Tambah telur dan keju.
descriptionEn: Spicy Korean instant noodles. Add egg and cheese.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Ayam tandoori dalam kuah tomato dan mentega yang berkrim.
descriptionEn: Tandoori chicken in a mild, creamy tomato and butter gravy.

name: Tandoori Chicken
description: Ayam perap yogurt dan rempah, dibakar dalam ketuhar tanah liat.
descriptionEn: Yoghurt and spice marinated chicken roasted in a clay oven.

name: Cheese Naan
description: Roti leper lembut dibakar, kosong, bawang putih atau keju.
descriptionEn: Soft oven-baked flatbread, plain, garlic or stuffed with cheese.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Keju India dalam kuah bayam berempah. Vegetarian.
descriptionEn: Indian cottage cheese in smooth spiced spinach gravy. Vegetarian.

name: Chana Masala
description: Kacang kuda dalam kuah tomato berempah. Vegetarian.
descriptionEn: Chickpeas in tangy spiced tomato gravy. Vegetarian.

name: Samosa
description: Pastri segi tiga rangup berinti kentang dan kacang pea berempah.
descriptionEn: Crispy triangle pastry filled with spiced potato and peas.

name: Masala Chai
description: Teh susu dimasak dengan halia, buah pelaga dan kayu manis.
descriptionEn: Milk tea brewed with ginger, cardamom and cinnamon.

name: Mango Lassi
description: Minuman yogurt sejuk dikisar dengan mangga masak.
descriptionEn: Cold yoghurt drink blended with ripe mango.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Bebola doh susu lembut direndam sirap mawar dan buah pelaga.
descriptionEn: Soft milk dough balls soaked in rose and cardamom syrup.

name: Idli
description: Kuih beras kukus dengan sambar dan chutney kelapa.
descriptionEn: Steamed rice cakes with sambar and coconut chutney.

name: Pani Puri
description: Puri rangup berongga diisi air berempah dan kentang. Sekali suap.
descriptionEn: Crispy hollow puris filled with spiced water and potato. One bite each.

name: Dal Makhani
description: Kacang dal hitam dimasak perlahan dengan mentega dan krim. Vegetarian.
descriptionEn: Slow-cooked black lentils with butter and cream. Vegetarian.

name: Nihari
description: Rebusan daging lembu dimasak perlahan, pekat berempah. Makan dengan naan.
descriptionEn: Slow-cooked beef stew, rich and spiced. Eat with naan.

name: Chicken Karahi
description: Ayam dimasak dalam kuali dengan tomato, halia dan cili hijau.
descriptionEn: Chicken cooked in a wok with tomato, ginger and green chilli.

name: Kottu Roti
description: Roti dicincang, digoreng dengan telur, sayur dan kari atas plat panas.
descriptionEn: Chopped roti stir-fried with egg, vegetables and curry on a hot plate.

name: Appam
description: Apam beras berbentuk mangkuk, tepi rangup dan tengah lembut.
descriptionEn: Bowl-shaped rice pancakes, crispy edges and soft centre.

name: Momo
description: Ladu kukus dengan achar tomato pedas.
descriptionEn: Steamed dumplings with spicy tomato achar.

name: Shawarma
description: Ayam atau daging panggang berputar dibalut dengan sos bawang putih dan jeruk.
descriptionEn: Spit-roasted chicken or beef wrapped with garlic sauce and pickles.

name: Falafel
description: Cucur kacang kuda rangup dengan tahini, dalam pita atau pinggan.
descriptionEn: Crispy chickpea fritters with tahini, in pita or on a plate.

name: Hummus
description: Celup kacang kuda dan tahini dengan minyak zaitun dan pita panas.
descriptionEn: Smooth chickpea and tahini dip with olive oil and warm pita.

name: Nasi Mandi
description: Nasi berempah Yaman dengan ayam atau kambing panggang lembut.
descriptionEn: Yemeni spiced rice with tender roast chicken or lamb.

name: Kabsa
description: Nasi berempah Arab Saudi dengan ayam, kismis dan badam.
descriptionEn: Saudi spiced rice with chicken, raisins and almonds.

name: Kunafa
description: Pastri halus rangup atas keju cair, disiram sirap.
descriptionEn: Crispy shredded pastry over melted cheese, soaked in syrup.

name: Baklava
description: Lapisan pastri nipis, kacang dan sirap madu.
descriptionEn: Layers of flaky pastry, nuts and honey syrup.

name: Shakshuka
description: Telur dimasak dalam sos tomato dan lada berempah. Cicah dengan roti.
descriptionEn: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and pepper sauce. Dip with bread.

name: Fattoush
description: Salad rangup dengan pita bakar, sumac dan lemon.
descriptionEn: Crunchy salad with toasted pita, sumac and lemon.

name: Doner Kebab
description: Daging panggang berputar dihiris dalam roti dengan salad dan sos.
descriptionEn: Sliced rotisserie meat in bread with salad and sauce.

name: Pide
description: Roti Turki berbentuk perahu dibakar dengan keju, telur atau daging cincang.
descriptionEn: Boat-shaped Turkish flatbread baked with cheese, egg or minced meat.

name: Pizza Margherita
description: Kerak nipis dengan tomato, mozzarella dan daun selasih. Yang asal.
descriptionEn: Thin crust with tomato, mozzarella and basil. The classic.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Pasta dengan telur, keju pecorino dan babi awet. Versi halal guna daging.
descriptionEn: Pasta with egg, pecorino and cured pork. Halal versions use beef.

name: Lasagna
description: Lapisan pasta, sos daging dan béchamel dibakar dengan keju.
descriptionEn: Layers of pasta, meat sauce and béchamel baked with cheese.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Nasi Itali berkrim dimasak perlahan dengan cendawan dan parmesan.
descriptionEn: Creamy Italian rice slowly cooked with mushrooms and parmesan.

name: Tiramisu
description: Biskut direndam kopi berlapis mascarpone. Selalunya ada arak.
descriptionEn: Coffee-soaked biscuits layered with mascarpone. Often has liqueur.

name: Gelato
description: Aiskrim Itali yang padat dan lembut.
descriptionEn: Dense, silky Italian ice cream.

name: Croissant
description: Pastri bulan sabit bermentega dan rangup. Paling sedap panas dengan kopi.
descriptionEn: Buttery, flaky crescent pastry. Best warm with coffee.

name: Crêpe
description: Lempeng nipis Perancis dengan Nutella, pisang atau gula dan lemon.
descriptionEn: Thin French pancake with Nutella, banana or sugar and lemon.

name: Ratatouille
description: Rebusan Provence terung, zukini, lada benggala dan tomato.
descriptionEn: Provençal stew of aubergine, courgette, peppers and tomato.

name: Quiche Lorraine
description: Tart telur dan krim, biasanya dengan bacon.
descriptionEn: Savoury egg and cream tart, traditionally with bacon.

name: Coq au Vin
description: Ayam direbus dalam wain merah dengan cendawan dan bawang.
descriptionEn: Chicken braised in red wine with mushrooms and onions.

name: French Onion Soup
description: Sup bawang karamel di bawah roti dan keju cair. Selalunya ada wain.
descriptionEn: Caramelised onion soup under bread and melted cheese. Often has wine.

name: Macarons
description: Biskut meringue badam rangup dengan inti berkrim.
descriptionEn: Crisp almond meringue cookies with a creamy filling.

name: Crème Brûlée
description: Kastard vanila dengan lapisan gula karamel yang rangup.
descriptionEn: Vanilla custard with a crackly caramelised sugar top.

name: Paella
description: Nasi kunyit kesumba dalam kuali dengan makanan laut. Ada yang tambah chorizo.
descriptionEn: Saffron rice pan with seafood. Some versions add chorizo.

name: Churros
description: Doh goreng bergula, dicicah coklat.
descriptionEn: Fried dough sticks rolled in sugar, dipped in chocolate.

name: Gazpacho
description: Sup tomato dan sayur kisar yang sejuk untuk hari panas.
descriptionEn: Cold blended tomato and vegetable soup for hot days.

name: Tortilla Española
description: Telur dadar tebal Sepanyol dengan kentang dan bawang.
descriptionEn: Thick Spanish omelette with potato and onion.

name: Gyros
description: Pita berbalut daging panggang, tzatziki, tomato dan bawang.
descriptionEn: Pita wrap with roasted meat, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

name: Moussaka
description: Lapisan terung, daging cincang berempah dan béchamel dibakar.
descriptionEn: Baked layers of aubergine, spiced minced meat and béchamel.

name: Greek Salad
description: Tomato, timun, zaitun dan keju feta dengan minyak zaitun.
descriptionEn: Tomato, cucumber, olives and a slab of feta with olive oil.

name: Fish and Chips
description: Ikan goreng tepung dengan kentang tebal dan sos tartar.
descriptionEn: Battered fried fish with thick chips and tartare sauce.

name: Full English Breakfast
description: Telur, bacon, sosej, kacang, roti bakar dan tomato bakar.
descriptionEn: Eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, toast and grilled tomato.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Rebusan kambing cincang dibakar di bawah kentang lenyek.
descriptionEn: Minced lamb stew baked under creamy mashed potato.

name: Schnitzel
description: Kepingan daging nipis bersalut tepung roti. Babi atau anak lembu, ayam untuk halal.
descriptionEn: Thin breaded cutlet fried golden. Pork or veal, chicken for halal.

name: Bratwurst
description: Sosej babi Jerman bakar dengan mustard dan sauerkraut.
descriptionEn: Grilled German pork sausage with mustard and sauerkraut.

name: Pretzel
description: Roti bersimpul kenyal dengan kulit masin.
descriptionEn: Chewy knotted bread with a salty crust.

name: Borscht
description: Sup ubi bit merah pekat dengan krim masam.
descriptionEn: Deep red beetroot soup with sour cream.

name: Pierogi
description: Ladu Poland berinti kentang dan keju, dengan bawang goreng.
descriptionEn: Polish dumplings filled with potato and cheese, served with onions.

name: Goulash
description: Rebusan daging Hungary yang kaya dengan paprika.
descriptionEn: Hungarian beef stew rich with paprika.

name: Mac and Cheese
description: Makaroni dibakar dalam sos keju yang pekat dan meleleh.
descriptionEn: Macaroni baked in a thick, gooey cheese sauce.

name: Pancakes
description: Lempeng gebu bertingkat dengan mentega dan sirap maple.
descriptionEn: Fluffy stacked pancakes with butter and maple syrup.

name: BBQ Ribs
description: Rusuk diasap perlahan dalam sos BBQ melekit. Biasanya babi; ada rusuk lembu.
descriptionEn: Slow-smoked ribs in sticky barbecue sauce. Usually pork; beef ribs exist.

name: Buffalo Wings
description: Kepak ayam goreng digaul sos pedas, dengan celup keju biru.
descriptionEn: Fried chicken wings tossed in hot sauce, with blue cheese dip.

name: Apple Pie
description: Inti epal kayu manis dalam pastri bermentega. Tambah aiskrim.
descriptionEn: Cinnamon apple filling in buttery pastry. Add a scoop of ice cream.

name: Brownies
description: Kek coklat padat dan kenyal berbentuk segi empat.
descriptionEn: Fudgy, chewy chocolate squares.

name: Tacos
description: Tortila jagung lembut dengan daging bakar, salsa, bawang dan limau.
descriptionEn: Soft corn tortillas with grilled meat, salsa, onion and lime.

name: Burrito
description: Tortila besar membalut nasi, kacang, daging dan keju.
descriptionEn: Big flour tortilla wrapped around rice, beans, meat and cheese.

name: Quesadilla
description: Tortila bakar dilipat dengan keju cair dan inti.
descriptionEn: Toasted tortilla folded over melted cheese and fillings.

name: Nachos
description: Kerepek tortila dengan keju, jalapeño dan salsa.
descriptionEn: Tortilla chips piled with cheese, jalapeños and salsa.

name: Guacamole
description: Avokado lenyek dengan limau, bawang dan daun ketumbar, dengan kerepek.
descriptionEn: Mashed avocado with lime, onion and coriander, with chips.

name: Enchiladas
description: Tortila bergulung berisi ayam, dibakar dalam sos cili.
descriptionEn: Rolled tortillas filled with chicken, baked in chilli sauce.

name: Feijoada
description: Rebusan kacang hitam Brazil dengan babi salai, dimakan dengan nasi.
descriptionEn: Brazilian black bean stew with smoked pork, served with rice.

name: Pão de Queijo
description: Roti keju bulat Brazil yang kenyal.
descriptionEn: Chewy Brazilian cheese bread balls.

name: Açaí Bowl
description: Kisaran beri açaí sejuk dengan granola dan buah.
descriptionEn: Frozen açaí berry blend topped with granola and fruit.

name: Churrasco
description: BBQ Brazil: daging bakar dihiris terus dari cucuk.
descriptionEn: Brazilian barbecue: grilled meats sliced straight from skewers.

name: Ceviche
description: Ikan mentah diperap jus limau dengan cili dan bawang merah. Kebanggaan Peru.
descriptionEn: Raw fish cured in lime juice with chilli and red onion. Peru's pride.

name: Lomo Saltado
description: Daging lembu goreng Peru dengan tomato, bawang dan kentang goreng.
descriptionEn: Peruvian beef stir-fry with tomato, onion and fries.

name: Empanadas
description: Pastri bakar atau goreng berinti daging berempah.
descriptionEn: Baked or fried pastries filled with spiced beef.

name: Poutine
description: Kentang goreng Kanada dengan keju dadih dan kuah panas.
descriptionEn: Canadian fries with cheese curds and hot gravy.

name: Jerk Chicken
description: Ayam Jamaica diperap rempah dan cili Scotch bonnet, kemudian dibakar.
descriptionEn: Jamaican chicken marinated in allspice and Scotch bonnet, then grilled.

name: Poke Bowl
description: Mangkuk Hawaii tuna atau salmon mentah atas nasi dengan bijan dan kicap.
descriptionEn: Hawaiian bowl of raw tuna or salmon over rice with sesame and soy.

name: Chicken Tagine
description: Ayam Maghribi dimasak perlahan dengan lemon jeruk dan zaitun.
descriptionEn: Moroccan slow-cooked chicken with preserved lemon and olives.

name: Couscous
description: Semolina kukus yang gebu dengan sayur dan rebusan.
descriptionEn: Fluffy steamed semolina with vegetables and stew.

name: Injera with Doro Wat
description: Roti leper Ethiopia yang berongga dengan rebusan ayam pedas. Makan guna tangan.
descriptionEn: Spongy Ethiopian flatbread with spicy chicken stew. Eat with your hands.

name: Jollof Rice
description: Nasi tomato dan lada Afrika Barat, berasap dan pedas.
descriptionEn: West African tomato and pepper rice, smoky and spicy.

name: Bunny Chow
description: Roti buku yang dikorek dan diisi kari. Makanan jalanan Durban.
descriptionEn: Hollowed-out bread loaf filled with curry. Durban street food.

name: Koshari
description: Campuran Mesir nasi, kacang dal, pasta dan sos tomato pedas.
descriptionEn: Egyptian mix of rice, lentils, pasta and spicy tomato sauce.

name: Meat Pie
description: Pai Australia saiz tapak tangan berinti daging cincang dan kuah.
descriptionEn: Australian hand-sized pie with minced beef and gravy.

name: Pavlova
description: Meringue rangup dengan krim putar dan buah segar.
descriptionEn: Crisp meringue with whipped cream and fresh fruit.

name: Lamingtons
description: Kek span dicelup coklat dan kelapa kering.
descriptionEn: Sponge cake squares dipped in chocolate and coconut.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Roti masam dengan avokado lenyek, lemon dan serpihan cili. Brunch kafe.
descriptionEn: Sourdough with smashed avocado, lemon and chilli flakes. Café brunch.

name: Fried Chicken
description: Ayam goreng rangup dan berjus. Original atau pedas?
descriptionEn: Crispy, juicy fried chicken. Original or spicy?

name: Beef Burger
description: Daging burger, keju, salad dan sos dalam roti lembut.
descriptionEn: Beef patty, cheese, lettuce and sauce in a soft bun.

name: Chicken Burger
description: Burger isi ayam goreng rangup, selalunya ada pilihan pedas.
descriptionEn: Crispy fried chicken fillet burger, often with a spicy option.

name: French Fries
description: Kentang goreng keemasan bergaram. Cicah sos cili atau sundae.
descriptionEn: Golden fries, salted. Dip in chilli sauce or a sundae.

name: Chicken Nuggets
description: Ayam bersalut tepung saiz sekali gigit dengan sos celup.
descriptionEn: Bite-sized breaded chicken with dipping sauces.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
description: Piza penghantaran dengan pepperoni daging atau ayam dan keju melimpah.
descriptionEn: Delivery pizza with beef or chicken pepperoni and lots of cheese.

name: Hot Dog
description: Sosej dalam roti lembut dengan sos tomato dan mustard. Daging atau ayam.
descriptionEn: Sausage in a soft bun with ketchup and mustard. Beef or chicken.

name: Sub Sandwich
description: Sandwic panjang dengan pilihan daging, keju dan sayur.
descriptionEn: Long sandwich with your pick of meat, cheese and vegetables.

name: Milkshake
description: Minuman aiskrim kisar yang pekat. Coklat, vanila atau strawberi.
descriptionEn: Thick blended ice cream drink. Chocolate, vanilla or strawberry.

name: Ice Cream Sundae
description: Aiskrim lembut dengan sos coklat atau karamel.
descriptionEn: Soft serve with chocolate or caramel sauce.

name: Rice with Fried Chicken
description: Set nasi makanan segera dengan ayam goreng dan sos. Sangat Malaysia.
descriptionEn: Fast-food rice meal with fried chicken and sauce. Very Malaysian.
